tournament.label: Tournament (6-max, NLHE)
tournament.description: Simplified preflop ranges for common stack depths. Start tight from early position and widen late positions.

positions.name: UTG / LJ
positions.notes: Prioritize hands that play well all-in; avoid small pairs and offsuit Broadways.

positions.name: HJ
positions.notes: Add suited connectors rarely; most play is shove/fold at this depth.

positions.name: CO
positions.notes: You can pressure blinds with suited Broadways and mid pairs.

positions.name: BTN
positions.notes: Widen opens and resteals with suited Ax and Broadways; protect stack with value 3-bets.

positions.name: SB
positions.notes: Shove or raise/fold; avoid weak offsuit hands out of position.

positions.name: UTG / LJ
positions.notes: Stay disciplined; offsuit Broadways and small pairs perform poorly.

positions.name: HJ
positions.notes: Mix a few suited connectors and suited wheel aces as steals.

positions.name: CO
positions.notes: CO is your volume position: add suited connectors and wider Ax.

positions.name: BTN
positions.notes: Press the blinds with suited gappers and offsuit Broadways; 3-bet value + a few suited Ax bluffs.

positions.name: SB
positions.notes: Complete more versus limps, but isolate with playable suited hands.

cash.label: Cash (6-max, NLHE)
cash.description: Baseline open/defend guidance for $1/$2 live or 100bb online games.

positions.name: UTG / LJ
positions.notes: Tight value open; avoid offsuit Broadways and small suited gappers.

positions.name: HJ
positions.notes: Mix suited connectors as calls versus tough blinds; 3-bet value heavy.

positions.name: CO
positions.notes: Attack blinds; include suited wheel aces as light 3-bets.

positions.name: BTN
positions.notes: Max pressure spot: wide opens and a polarized 3-bet range.

positions.name: SB vs open
positions.notes: Defend tightly vs big opens; mix suited Ax 3-bet bluffs versus late position.

positions.name: BB vs open
positions.notes: Defend with price but avoid dominated offsuit hands versus EP.
